name: What plumbing upgrades should I consider for a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What plumbing upgrades should I consider for a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a bathroom remodel, consider upgrading to low-flow toilets and showerheads to conserve water. Replacing old galvanized or polybutylene pipes with PEX or copper can prevent future leaks and improve water pressure. You might also want to relocate fixtures like the toilet or shower for a new layout, which requires significant plumbing work. Adding a bidet attachment or a dedicated hot water line for a tub filler are other popular upgrades. Consider your long-term needs and the age of your home's existing plumbing system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider low-flow fixtures, pipe replacement, fixture relocation, or adding a bidet for a more efficient and modern bathroom.
